sources.title: Zebra-CoT: A Dataset for Interleaved Vision Language Reasoning
sources.snippet: Fine-tuning Bagel-7B yields a model that generates high-quality interleaved visual reasoning chains, underscoring Zebra-CoT's effectiveness for developing multimodal reasoning abilities. We open-source our dataset and models to support development and evaluation of visual CoT.
